notes.title: Square of Joy v. 1.35 – QoL
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135558/78643e1782343dd63f236dd4169fbf4c95559e56.png
Howdy!
This update introduces two Quality of Life features:

 Run Timer: handy if you wanna speedrun. It pauses when you’re in the menus.
 Offline Score: your best height/time is displayed instead of leaderboard when playing offline.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135558/e4ac977f7faac703e9702422675f61eba7a2be85.png
Btw. I just released Square of Joy on itch.io. It might be slightly cheaper there, but it doesn’t have those cool Steam-exclusive online features (Global Leaderboard, Friends, Shareable Achievements).

Until next time,
Marcin (Tinek) Michalski

notes.title: Square of Joy v. 1.1 – Progress
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135558/858b11ddea5acbd8a388a5b0a05c07fb58e5bd04.png
Hey there climbers! Welcome to version 1.1

 With this update I added a save system. All your accomplishments and scores were being saved on steam already, but now the game also saves your position on the level, so you don’t have to start over after restarting the game, and only then. So if you thought it would make it easier, it won’t.
 I also added a new reward for completing secret challenges: a joyful trail effect that stretches behind you.

Hope you'll like it. Until next time!
Marcin (Tinek) Michalski

notes.title: Square of Joy 0.8 - Master Race
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135558/16d3435ab1e4c25dda17bca39473534912c9e9d1.png
Hey there! No time for chit-chat, let’s dive right into patch notes!
What’s new?

 Added achievements: not your typical ‘just play the game and get all of them’, you're gonna need to use some brain (and finger) power.
 Added golden ‘master race’ skin to unlock. Trust me: game feels easier when you have it on.
What’s next?
More skins, ultimate secret, extra stone challenge (what?)...soon.

Cheers!
Marcin (Tinek) Michalski

notes.title: SoJ v. 0.7 – Steam Deck and Discord
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135558/45c90bbf91b64f95393612fa2adc47af077a70b5.png
News:
Hey there beautiful people. First thing I wanna share is that ‘Square of Joy’ has passed the steam review, so the release date (October 25, 2024) is secured.

I also launched a Discord server. It’s the easiest way to contact me, share your thoughts and also stay up to date with news and updates.

Patch Notes:

 Steam Deck (sup)port. Valve made it really easy and it works buttery smooth.
 Dynamic keybinding display, so you always see the controls of a connected input device, be it keyboard/gamepad/steamdeck.
 Second key binding scheme for keyboard (based on feedback).
 Polished the game ending.
 Finalized level design of all secrets.

What’s next?
Custom skins (and never ending enviro polish).

See you soon!
Marcin (Tinek) Michalski

notes.title: Square of Joy v. 0.6 – added controller support
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135558/4fe624bfadf93a686c8ba99e97d0bd008b559f7c.png
Update 0.6 - Patch Notes
Hey there beautiful people. All is going as planned. In this update I added:

 Sound Settings: master, effects and music volumes.
 Controller Support: it works automatically, switches between devices on input. In settings you can check recommended keybinds, but other buttons work as well so… experiment :)

Btw. when playing on keyboard, you can use arrows instead of WSAD now.

What’s next?
Currently polishing what I have for the steam build review, and after that I would like to add custom character skins. See you soon!
Marcin (Tinek) Michalski

notes.title: Steam page is up, alpha (v0.5) is ready - dev diary
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135558/449fa5474c11c89497a4edb3d617cecbb0407e80.png
Where am I now?
Hey! So the store page is live, my game is ‘coming soon’ - achievement unlocked, milestone reached. Speaking of those, version 0.5 in my measure means that the project has entered alpha state: all core mechanics are in and the game works as a whole.
Main level and all the secrets are designed and built, but some of them aren’t pretty yet. Music is done, but some sounds are missing, and so on..
Is it gonna be like that?
Currently I’m working on settings. In the near future I would like to add controller support. Also slowly but surely replacing art placeholders with actual graphics.

That’s all for now. See you in the next update!
Marcin (Tinek) Michalski
